label: McIntyre Lake western lake–stream junction
identity_evidence: McIntyre Lake is north/northeast of the three-armed upper McMillan basin and west/northwest of Buchanan Lake. The western shoreline convergence is visible below the lake label and meets the westward single-stream continuation. Modern lake shores 131784/131786 meet stream 198494 at that coordinate. The whole centroid was withheld because the northern shore is obscured by the Mills label; no hidden boundary was reconstructed. Flow direction is not inferred from the endpoint order.
phase: New post-freeze check, not fit. Shares the western mainland region with McMillan control R21; not a distinct whole-panel region.
